# serde 1 / serde_json 1 — 2026-09-14

- https://crates.io/crates/serde
- https://crates.io/crates/serde_json
- license: MIT OR Apache-2.0

`serde` + `derive` for request bodies `{username,text}` and cursor files `{server,tenant,channel,after}`. `serde_json::Value` for pass-through server JSON and `{error:{code,message}}`. Success stdout prints the trimmed server body so key order stays the server’s.
